title: Smooth Material Modal Height & Whole-Modal Swipe Motion
summary: Stabilizes material modal dimensions and improves swipe transitions by animating the entire modal card.

changes.text: Modal Height Stability: added fixed modal height with responsive flex-sizing for the description lore box to prevent vertical jumping when switching materials.
Whole-Modal Swipe Motion: animated the entire modal card with tilt and fade on mobile swipe gestures and next/prev navigation rather than only sliding inner content.
